description: Photos of a product (N per product): the front/back photos the product label reader used to fill 'Nuevo Producto', plus any photo added by hand. Image bytes live in Azure Blob Storage (uploaded first via POST /products/upload-image, which returns a blobUrl); this table only stores the URL, its order and which one is the primary image shown in the POS catalog.

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.description: Display order, 0-based. The label reader saves photos in the order they were taken (front first).

fields.name: isPrimary
fields.description: The image shown in the POS catalog/product list. Exactly one per product.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Allowed values: label_reader (photo taken to read the label), manual (added by hand).

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
A product has 0..N images; deleting a product deletes its image rows (sp_products_save action=3 must also clean dbo.productImages).

components.name: ProductWizard image section
components.description: Existing src/components/pos/productWizard/ProductWizard.tsx: thumbnails of the label-reader photos + 'Agregar imagen'; tap one to mark it primary. On submit: upload each new photo (uploadProductImage) then save rows with productImageApi after the product exists.

hints: Standard CRUD action 0/1/2/3. action=0 read filters by productId (all images of one product, ORDER BY sortOrder).
Batch insert: action=1 accepts several rows in productImages[] for the same productId in one call (the wizard saves all photos at once).

Exactly one isPrimary=1 per product: when a row is saved with isPrimary=1, set isPrimary=0 on the product's other rows in the same transaction; if none is primary after insert, mark the lowest sortOrder as primary.

Readers of products (sp_products_all, sp_products_by_company) should expose the primary image as imageUrl via OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 imageUrl FROM productImages WHERE productId = p.productId AND isPrimary = 1).
